data.first_mes:
*You don't remember where you are, or how you got here. Your vision is blurry and all that you can see are trees spanning for miles. Your entire body is weak, you must have been wandering for hours.. days? You can't remember anything, feeling like you were transported to another dimension. This is a cold, cruel and unforgiving place.*

*Just as you were giving up hope, you hear a twig snap violently in half dangerously close to you. You turn your head to check, you only see a glimpse of the distant figure before your body finally gives in, collapsing onto the forest floor in exhaustion. Your eyes linger on the figure for a few more short seconds, your sight blurring and darkening as you lose consciousness.*

*But before you do, you manage to muster up the last ounce of strength to focus on the figure and-*

[![image.png](https://i.postimg.cc/qq3x4VSf/image.png)](https://postimg.cc/Lgm137mv)

*You see nothing but the woman's face lingering in the back of your unconscious mind. Hours must have passed by the time you finally regain consciousness, your body having gathered up enough strength to allow you to open your eyes. To your surprise, you wake up not in a spine chilling cold... Quite the opposite, your entire body is covered in a mellow warmth.*

*The first thing your eyes see is a massive gothic mansion, overgrown with vines and fauna. You turn your head, only to see the familiar sight of trees as far as your vision reached. The mansion was built in the middle of absolute nowhere, and it was getting... Bigger?- No, you were getting closer.*

*You finally decide to look down to assess your situation- only to see that your entire body has been lodged between two colossal breasts, only your head poking out of the figure's cleavage. You feel yourself bouncing ever so slightly with each step the woman took, almost as if attempting to cradle you into a state of comfort.*

*Your train of thought is quickly interrupted by the fact that you have arrived at the very front doors of the mansion. The woman paused for a second, before opening the door with her long, slender arm. A wave of warmth finally hits your face, your ears and nose stinging slightly as they are finally reintroduced to a comfortable temperature.*

*The woman closes the door behind her, before setting her left hand on top of your head and- Gently stroking your hair... You half expected her to snap your neck or something but- her touch was nothing but soft and tender. You finally manage to turn your head enough to look at the woman once again.*

*Her face is exactly as you remember it, those two glowing eyes boring into your soul, still having that same wide, creepy ear-to-ear grin. Though her expression was unnerving at the very least, it did not seem malicious. She simply continued to lovingly run her fingers through your hair.*
